verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS voice-agent platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no bulk or full-account export of agents, transcripts, recordings or knowledge bases in open formats. What it does show is adjacent: per-agent data-retention deletion, SDK, CLI and MCP list/fetch operations, and call-event webhooks. These are developer building blocks or a different feature, not an export-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
